purpose: Exploratory causal phase-policy tracking screen. The two tracking gains were fixed before schedule calibration; each schedule is frozen before holdout.

protocol.online_information: public recurring task phase, current demand, and current SOC only
protocol.shared_constraints: 60 kW stable floor, 40 kW/s applied engine ramp, 150 kW motor and battery-bus limits
protocol.selection_rule: hard-validity then mean-fuel coordinate search on six development seeds
protocol.holdout_rule: evaluate both fixed-gain development schedules on 14 disjoint seeds
